author: PI/OpenAI
purpose: Exploratory controlled-consequence and perspective pilot; selected for rich conflicts, not a representative sample or a confirmation set.
selection_basis: Two previously inspected disagreement cases plus ten varied game decisions selected from scenario text and actions. Original raw records, not existing summaries, supply generation context.

scenes.reason: Immediate rescue versus institutional future benefit; known exploratory disagreement.
Scarcity, dependants and expulsion; known feasibility-sensitive disagreement.
Medical supplies versus militia authority and public need.
Prisoner mistreatment versus dangers of indiscriminate release.
Lease obligations, financial loss and a tenant family's safety.
Property, truthfulness and protecting a pursued child.
Secrecy, witness autonomy and risks of disclosure.
Prisoner release, ransom and competing authorities.
Reporting misconduct, secrecy and coercive bargaining.
Protecting accused servants under royal authority.
Defence resources versus civilian property and protection.
